Aubree is a Flaming Fist led by  Counsellor Florrick to rescue  Duke Ravengard during Act Two.
“
An extra blade could be the difference between rescuing Duke Ravengard or losing him forever. I hope you'll help us.
„
— Aubree

Involvement

Act Two

Last Light Inn

Initially on a mission led by  Florrick to rescue  Ulder Ravengard, Aubree and the rest of the Fists were waylaid by the dangers of the Shadow-Cursed Lands and found refuge with the Harpers at Last Light Inn. Aubree is within the inn, in the same room as several other Fists, and  Art Cullagh. She is deeply loyal to Ravengard and is concerned for his safety after hearing stories about Moonrise Towers.[1]

If Florrick is not rescued from Waukeen's Rest in Act One, Aubree never appears in the game.

Resolve the Abduction

When  Marcus attacks the inn and attempts to kidnap  Isobel during ⁠Resolve the Abduction, Aubree more often than not fails her saving throw and is  Impaled for the remainder of the battle. If Isobel is not saved, Aubree and everyone in Last Light Inn turn into a  Shadow-Cursed Undead, save for  Jaheira.

After the battle, talking with Aubree results in her denouncing Marcus as scum, and swearing that she and the rest of the Fists are loyal to Ravengard.[2]

Assault Moonrise Towers

If Isobel is saved at the Last Light Inn and the  Nightsong is been freed from her cage and heads for Moonrise, Aubree is among the Fists left by Florrick to follow Jaheira to Moonrise Towers. However, Aubree is killed during the initial fight against Absolute forces before the party arrive. Her corpse is on the bridge leading to Moonrise, implying she was amongst the first to fall in battle.
